boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Auburn University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops spanning downtown Auburn, campus dining, and the city’s five distinct Waffle House locations. Verify day-specific hours before leaving.

cards.title: Pizza Past Midnight
cards.subtitle: Downtown on East Magnolia Avenue
cards.notes: Walk from central campus for pizza, calzones, or sandwiches; check the posted schedule because Sunday closes considerably earlier.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizzeria with service into the early morning six nights each week.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant lists hours until 2:00 a.m. Monday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 129 E Magnolia Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Monday–Thursday 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.; Friday–Saturday 11:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m.; Sunday 11:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.

cards.title: The Late Wing Pickup
cards.subtitle: South Gay Street near campus
cards.notes: Place a pickup order before making the trip; the restaurant says third-party delivery is also available after its own delivery change.
cards.short_summary: An evening-only wing counter that keeps weekend pickup available until 2:00 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Proud Willie's lists current hours of 4:30 p.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 4:30 p.m.–2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Proud Willie's – Set your alarm for 4:30 pm
cards.access_notes: Current posted hours: Sunday–Thursday 4:30 p.m.–12:00 a.m.; Friday–Saturday 4:30 p.m.–2:00 a.m. Pickup and third-party delivery are offered.

cards.title: A Rooftop Late-Night Menu
cards.subtitle: 146 North Gay Street
cards.notes: Review the dress code before going and arrive by 10:00 p.m. for weekend dining-room seating; later seating moves to the bar area.
cards.short_summary: A rooftop Italian restaurant with a dedicated late-night menu and explicit all-ages access above age ten.
cards.evidence_claim: Olivine lists Friday–Saturday hours until 12:30 a.m., links a late-night menu, and states that all guests must be at least ten years old.
cards.access_notes: Friday–Saturday hours are 5:00 p.m.–12:30 a.m. Dining-room seating ends at 10:00 p.m. on weekends; later seating is first-come in the bar area. Minimum age is 10.

cards.title: Dinner at the Auburn Hotel
cards.subtitle: Across South College Street from campus
cards.notes: Use the restaurant entrance inside The Hotel at Auburn University and plan around the published 10:00 p.m. dinner cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A university-connected Italian dining room serving dinner beside the central campus edge.
cards.evidence_claim: The direct restaurant profile lists Ariccia at 241 S College Street and publishes dinner service from 5:30 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published dinner hours are 5:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m. daily. The separate Piccolo and bar schedule should not be treated as dinner-room availability.

cards.title: A Dining-Hall Nightcap
cards.subtitle: Central campus on Duncan Drive
cards.notes: Check the live campus-dining schedule before walking over, especially on Friday and Saturday when service may end earlier.
cards.short_summary: A central all-you-care-to-eat dining hall with weekday service extending to 10:00 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Auburn University Dining lists The Edge at Central Dining among its official locations and publishes service through 10:00 p.m. on multiple weekdays.
cards.source_title: The Edge at Central Dining - Auburn University
cards.access_notes: The current dining schedule should be checked for the visit date; published weekday service extends to 10:00 p.m., with earlier Friday and Saturday closing.

cards.title: The Downtown Waffle House
cards.subtitle: 110 West Glenn Avenue
cards.notes: Choose this branch for the shortest Waffle House run from downtown campus, then confirm live service status on its official location page.
cards.short_summary: The Waffle House branch positioned beside downtown Auburn and the north campus edge.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House's official locator identifies restaurant #1882 at 110 West Glenn Avenue in Auburn and provides online ordering from the location page.
cards.access_notes: The official location page provides current service status for this continuously operating late-night format; confirm the displayed status immediately before departure.

cards.title: The South College Counter
cards.subtitle: 2167 South College Street
cards.notes: Treat this as a driving run south of campus and verify the branch’s live status before leaving, particularly during severe weather.
cards.short_summary: A South College Street diner serving the hotel and residential corridor below campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House's official Auburn locator identifies restaurant #1035 at 2167 South College Street and links its dedicated location page.
cards.access_notes: The official location page provides current service status for this continuously operating late-night format; confirm the displayed status immediately before departure.

cards.title: The Opelika Road Run
cards.subtitle: 1738 Opelika Road
cards.notes: Use this branch when traveling east toward the Auburn Mall corridor; confirm current service status on the official page first.
cards.short_summary: An east-Auburn diner on the commercial route connecting campus with Opelika.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House's official Auburn locator lists restaurant #1166 at 1738 Opelika Road and supplies a dedicated ordering and location page.
cards.access_notes: The official location page provides current service status for this continuously operating late-night format; confirm the displayed status immediately before departure.

cards.title: The Bent Creek Detour
cards.subtitle: 2346 Bent Creek Road
cards.notes: Plan this as a car trip to east Auburn and check the live restaurant status before committing to the longer run from campus.
cards.short_summary: A named east-side branch near the Bent Creek Road and Interstate 85 area.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House's official location page identifies restaurant #1646 at 2346 Bent Creek Road in Auburn and offers online ordering.
cards.access_notes: The official location page provides current service status for this continuously operating late-night format; confirm the displayed status immediately before departure.

cards.title: The North College Run
cards.subtitle: 1520 North College Street
cards.notes: Head north from downtown for this branch and use its official location page to confirm service before starting the drive.
cards.short_summary: A North College Street diner serving the corridor above downtown Auburn.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House's official Auburn locator identifies restaurant #2542 at 1520 North College Street and links its dedicated location page.
cards.access_notes: The official location page provides current service status for this continuously operating late-night format; confirm the displayed status immediately before departure.
